title: Find the names of superheroes who are taller than 70% of the average height
question: Find the names of superheroes who are taller than 70% of the average height, have blue eyes and blond hair, possess at least one attribute with a value between 70 and 85, and do not have any attribute named 'Durability' with a value below 40.

arguments.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1."XCL_022" = T2."XCL_005"
INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1."XCL_023" = T3."XCL_005"
WHERE T2."XCL_006" = 'Blue'
  AND T3."XCL_006" = 'Blond'
  AND T1."XCL_028" > 0.7 * (SELECT AVG("XCL_028") FROM superhero)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM hero_attribute AS T4
    WHERE T4."XCL_009" = T1."XCL_018" AND T4."XCL_011" BETWEEN 70 AND 85
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM hero_attribute AS T5
    INNER JOIN attribute AS T6 ON T5."XCL_010" = T6."XCL_003"
    WHERE T5."XCL_009" = T1."XCL_018" AND T6."XCL_004" = 'Durability' AND T5."XCL_011" < 40
  );
